changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwdischargeplanning AS SELECT dp.id, dp.patient_id, dp.encounter_id, dp.expected_discharge_date, dp.estimated_los, dp.readiness_status, dp.medical_condition_stable, dp.vitals_stable, dp.pending_investigations, dp.mobility_adl_status, dp.diagnosis_code, dp.diagnosis_name, dp.final_med_reconciliation_completed, dp.discharge_summary_prepared, dp.discharge_orders_signed, dp.nursing_discharge_report_done, dp.patient_family_informed, dp.transport_arranged, dp.medical_equipment, dp.home_care_needed, dp.post_discharge_dietary_plan, dp.post_discharge_social_needs, dp.topics_covered, dp.education_dietary_plan, dp.education_social_needs, dp.material_leaflet, dp.material_verbal, dp.material_video, dp.education_provided, dp.patient_understanding, dp.is_active, dp.created_date, dp.created_by, dp.last_modified_by, dp.last_modified_date FROM public.discharge_planning dp;

changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
